name: Movie Star Hero

start.dialog: Hey hey! I'm Laguna! Used to be a soldier, now I'm an actor! Making a movie here in the Prism - 'The Sorceress Wars: The Musical!' Need extras! Wanna be in a movie?
start.objective: Participate as an extra in Laguna's movie filming

progress.dialog: Action! No, wait - you're supposed to fall when I shoot! That's the joke! Okay, take two!
progress.objective: Perform various scenes for the movie

complete.dialog: And... CUT! That's a wrap! You were great! Natural talent! Here - hero's autograph! And this machine gun. From my army days. Still works!

party_comments.kade: He's... something else. But genuinely nice.
party_comments.twist: I'm gonna be FAMOUS! In the movies!
party_comments.nix7: Subject's optimism: infectious. Combat record: surprisingly impressive.

hidden_outcome: If you nail every scene on the first take, Laguna casts you as the co-star and gives you 'Machine Gun Friendship' - ultimate gun technique
